Overview

Kyzylorda is a city in Kyzylorda with a population of 300,000. A city in southern Kazakhstan on the Syr Darya River, a center for rice cultivation and oil production. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.0.
